releases.displayName: First Free Content Update: [Furious Trial] is Now Live!

items.text: The hidden darkness has returned once again, corrupting all the Elemental Lords. The gates of the Furious Trial are now open for the mightiest adventurers!

A new challenge, [Furious Trial], is now available. After defeating the [Raging King Boar] and obtaining any of the [Elemental Spirits], you can interact with the blue pig to challenge the corresponding furious Elemental Lord.
In the [Furious Trial], players will be rewarded based on their challenge duration with Gold, Silver, or Bronze Cups.
12 powerful BOSS equipment items have been added. Defeat the BOSS in [Furious Trial] and achieve different trophies to collect them.
Added a reward, the [Rune Robes], for completing the collection of [Blank Stele]. If you have already collected them all, simply teleport to [the Floating Island] to automatically receive the reward.
Fixed some issues affecting the experience in the [Temple of the Elements].
We are also running a new Event! The [Furious Trial] Event
To showcase your strenght, we have prepared this Trial Event for you.
Record a video of your battle against ones of the bosses in the [Furious Trial] or
Snap a screenshot once you've beaten them
The timer in the upper right corner should be clearly visible on your video or screenshot
Share the video or screenshot on your Social Media (in public) with the hashtag #KAKUFuriousTrial or share it in our Discord's FuriousTrial channel
From September 2nd until September 10th 11.59PM
Videos and Screenshots must be original and can not be resubmissions.
🥇1st place: 50$ Steam Card
🥈2nd place: 25$ Steam Card
🥉3rd place: 10$ Steam Card

We will continue to update the game with new content in the future. If you have any great ideas or suggestions, please leave them in the comments. Your thoughts might be added to the game one day. Thank you all for your support!
